name: Thats It
description: That's It! is a western domino game played with a double-15 set, providing a very large tile pool for longer sessions and larger tables. Players use standard matching placements while managing mobility and pip exposure with higher-number tiles that increase blocking complexity and swingy end control.

overview.description: That's It! is a western domino game played with a double-15 set, providing a very large tile pool for longer sessions and larger tables. Players use standard matching placements while managing mobility and pip exposure with higher-number tiles that increase blocking complexity and swingy end control.

history.origins: Double-15 domino games are encountered as modern North American-style expansions that use very large domino sets for long sessions and larger groups.
timeline: Modern era: larger commercial domino sets become widely available and used for specialized formats.
history.cultural: Played socially as a longer session game that benefits from careful mobility planning and defensive discarding of dangerous values.
history.evolution: As set size increases, end-control and blocking become more complex and high-number tiles amplify pip-risk management.

setup.dealing: Deal tiles by player count; remaining tiles form a boneyard if the profile uses draws.
setup.equipment: Domino set and optional score tracking by match profile.

rules.objective: Play legal matching tiles and finish the hand or match with the best score under the table profile.
rules.gameplay: Players place a legal tile to a matching open end of the shared layout. When blocked, the table profile determines whether to draw from a boneyard or pass. Hands end when a player empties their hand or play is blocked, and scoring follows the match profile.
keyRules: A played tile must match the value of an exposed open end.
Blocked turns are resolved by draw-or-pass profile rules.
Hand-end and scoring depend on the match profile in use.

strategy.basic: Avoid being trapped with high-number tiles; keep connectors that match multiple common end values.
strategy.intermediate: Because the set is large, track which high values are scarce and avoid opening them without support.
strategy.advanced: Control the open ends to force opponents into awkward values while maintaining your own safe exits across a wider value range.
tips: Treat high-number tiles as both power and risk; do not expose them without a plan.
Preserve flexible tiles that connect to multiple mid-range values.

synthesis.shortDescription: That's It! is a double-15 domino connecting game where higher values amplify blocking risk and end-control strategy.
